magic_moment.text: The equaliser that flipped the match — Al-Shehri pounced on hesitancy from Cristian Romero and finished low into the bottom corner, 1-1.
magic_moment.why: Shattered Argentina's assumption the game was won after Messi's penalty; the stadium and the underdog came alive.

magic_moment.text: The winner — Al-Dawsari plucked the ball from the sky, turned inside two defenders and curled it beyond Emi Martinez. 'One of the biggest moments of any World Cup.'
magic_moment.why: The technically spectacular goal that sealed the upset — replayed as a goal of the tournament.

narrative.storyline: Saudi's ultra-aggressive high line + offside trap
narrative.text: Saudi Arabia held one of the highest defensive lines of the tournament, stepping up in unison to spring the offside trap — Argentina had three first-half goals disallowed (Messi 22', Lautaro twice incl. a 27' dink).
narrative.why: Turned Argentina's main weapon (through-balls to runners) into non-events on the scoreboard.

narrative.text: Argentina dominated territory after the early penalty but kept playing the same vertical balls into the trap, never adjusting to pin the line deeper.
narrative.why: At 1-0 with three chalked-off goals, the underdog stayed alive, motivated and structurally confident.
